{{Quote|One time on Cyborrea, we had to drop from sixteen miles up! No air, full space gear&hellip;|A [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumper]]|<ref name="TotJ" />}}
Members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Army|Army's]] elite [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|rocket-jumper]] unit were sent on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cyborrea/Legends|Cyborrea]] at some point before the conflict known as the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]]<ref name="TotJ" /> that happened in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3998 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> During their assignment, the elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had to drop to the planet's surface with [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket packs]] and full [[Environment suit/Legends|space gears]] from an altitude of sixteen miles.<ref name="TotJ" />
